n: Event <Path of Life> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 10 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 25 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 40 times, not including tutorial stages.

theme: A recreation of the Abyssal Hunter lab from one of Secunda's sketches. Due to Rhodes Island's limited technology, most of the facilities lack their original functions, but for Ægir far from home, it might just be enough.

list:
You glimpsed the origin of the war between Ægir and the Seaborn.
They both hold a twisted spark. You must make a choice.
During Path of Life event, obtain Operator Underflow.

You have cooperated with Ægir's chosen envoy to land. With her, you built a bridge between the civilizations of land and sea.
At times, crossing the boundary between different forms of civilization is harder than crossing that between different forms of life.
During Path of Life event, spend 2400 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chips in [Materianomicon Moderatrix].

You find it hard to put down the Materianomicon Moderatrix. In the twinkle of an eye, this device can turn blueprint into reality.
Like many Ægir, you are obsessed with the experience of converting your idle thoughts into physical reality. It seems creating as you please is innate to all mankind.
Commemorative Medal 'Looking at the Path Ahead'
Complete all stages in [Deploy Beacons] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorial stages and story stages).

You witnessed Ægir's Waterway crossing the chaotic tides, pointing into the oceanic abyss.
You look at the Waterway stretching out to the horizon, and relief comes unbidden to you. Crisis is never far, but this time, civilization has a path forwards.
Commemorative Medal 'Birth of a New Philosophy'
Complete all the content in [Conundra of the Sophontheatrum] and collect the rewards.

You lost track of time at the Sophontheatrum, solving the riddles left behind by past generations of Ægir one by one.
These mysteries feed off your thoughts, multiplying endlessly like the Seaborn. But you feel no fear. The endless unknown is what you yearn for, after all.
Clear BP-7 with a 3-star rating, and charge the Waterway Beacon completely, activating its effect.

You taught yourself to use the Waterway Beacons, and the Academy of Technology operators couldn't help but sing your praises.
Unlike the cumbersome products of the land, Ægir devices operate as smoothly as flowing water.
Clear BP-EX-3 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Operators on at least 3 separate Excrescent Carapaces.

You exploited the Seaborn's 'carapace' process to give the legion fleets room to maneuver.
Using reason to infer instinct, much like using instinct to sense reason, is as difficult as bounding across the seas and striding into the sky. Perhaps you've learned how to take advantage of the Seaborn's instincts?
Complete all stages in [Fortify Defense] on Challenge Mode.

Before reinforcements from Ægir's home territories arrived, you held Milliarium alongside the Ægir, civilian and soldier alike.
Even after countless, countless years, you still protect the spark of civilization. In this case, who feels satisfaction, and who feels regret?
Clear BP-8 with 3 stars, and no more than 4 Operators retreat due to [Humanity's Bane] from Mártus, 'Seaborn'.

You did not yield when facing down the Seaborn once known as the sage Mártus.
It calmly recited your long-forgotten past, like reminiscing about an old friend. But these days, your faith will not be so easily swayed.
Defeat a total of 600 Sea Monster enemies in Path of Life event stages.

You aided the legions' fleets in suppressing a large amount of Seaborn.
You know the Seaborn issue cannot be resolved purely through violence, but you also know that every time the legions sweep a patch of sea clean, they are buying time for those seeking the truth of the matter.
set: Path of Life Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals recording the conflicts unfolding as the Ægir and Seaborn seek continued existence.
Ægir arrogantly represent civilization, while the Seaborn arrogantly represent life.
Between them, they will find a way to live on in the faded darkness. A path of life.
